description:
Liinks is the link-in-bio page for creators, sellers, and local businesses. Connect it and your assistant can manage the page you already keep current: add a link when a new episode, product, or post ships; reorder, hide, or restyle blocks; update your bio and social icons; and read what visitors did, from page views and clicks to form submissions and new subscribers.

Ask things like "How did my page do this week, and which link got the most clicks?", "Add my new podcast episode to the top of my page," or "Show me the form submissions I got since yesterday." Every change can be verified with a live screenshot of the page.

You stay in control. Connecting uses a Liinks consent screen where you approve exactly what the assistant may do (read your profile, edit it, read audience data, read analytics), tools declare whether they read or write so the assistant confirms edits before making them, and you can disconnect any time from your Liinks settings. Works with every Liinks account, on any plan.

defaultPrompt: How did my page do this week, and which link got the most clicks?
Add a link to my new podcast episode at the top of my page.
Show me the form submissions I got since yesterday.
